notes: Fixed: a stale pinned voice that pointed at a female voice is now cleared automatically, so a male setting no longer keeps speaking with a female voice.
Fixed: when no genuine male voice exists on the phone, the app now tries the en-GB male voice (Daniel / Google UK English Male) before falling back to the phone default.
Improved: voice diagnostics report the exact voice, pitch and attempt number used.
Male voice remains the default and is never silently replaced by a female voice.
